name: InterContinental Ras Al Khaimah Mina Al Arab Resort & Spa
positioning: Beach resort in Ras Al Khaimah offering private island living, set between the Arabian Gulf, the terracotta desert and the Hajar Mountains, about 45 minutes from Dubai
best_for: Beach lovers who want white-sand beaches and water sports
Families, with a kids' club and villas with room for family and friends
Couples wanting a private pool villa or a sea-view room with a balcony

facts.text: The resort is about 45 minutes from Dubai.
Classic Sea View Rooms have a private balcony.
Classic Sea View Rooms have smart-room technology.
Each villa offers in-villa dining and room for family and friends.
The Planet Trekkers Kids' Club runs activities focused on growth, curiosity and creativity.
Kids eat free at the resort.
Jet skis are available for rent at the beach.
Amarbar is a library-inspired bar with whiskeys and gins from around the world.
Jebel Jais, the highest peak in the United Arab Emirates, can be explored from the resort.

highlights.text: The resort offers private island living with white-sand beaches.
The resort sits between the Arabian Gulf, the terracotta desert and the Hajar Mountains.
The resort has beachfront private pool villas and seafront villas set in gardens steps from the beach.
SPA InterContinental offers skincare treatments, body therapies and traditional hammam rituals.
Classic Sea View Rooms are designed with Arabian decor and have Gulf views.

considerations.text: Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is about 30 kilometers from the hotel.
Pets are not allowed on the property.
WhataHotel notes the resort is outside Dubai city center, so urban attractions require travel.
